title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.
scope: 原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。
scopeEn: Background on atomic-scale deposition and etch; use the course technical references for detailed mechanisms.

title: imec：矽光子平台與應用導覽
watchFor: 把光源、導光、調變與偵測視為不同功能。
材料平台、設計套件及封裝限制需要一起選擇。
影片是早期平台導覽；現在的選項應查閱官方平台頁。
watchForEn: Separate the functions of light generation, guidance, modulation and detection.
Choose the material platform, design kit and packaging constraints together.
The video is an early platform overview; consult the official platform page for current options.
scope: 矽光子應用背景，不是任一課程元件的完整製造或測試影片。
scopeEn: Silicon-photonics application background, not a complete fabrication or test film for any individual device.

title: Lam：鉬金屬化與 ALTUS Halo
watchFor: 互連縮小時需要重新評估材料，而非只縮小幾何。
鉬是此產品案例的材料；不能直接套用到銅、鈷、釕或鎢課程。
比較電阻、薄膜沉積與整合限制，分開供應商說明及自己的驗證。
watchForEn: Shrinking interconnects requires reconsidering material choices, not only geometry.
Molybdenum belongs to this product case; do not transfer it directly to copper, cobalt, ruthenium or tungsten lessons.
Compare resistance, deposition and integration constraints while separating vendor statements from your verification.
scope: 用鉬 ALD 案例比較金屬互連材料轉換；不是其他金屬的通用配方。
scopeEn: Use the molybdenum-ALD case to compare interconnect material transitions; it is not a universal recipe for other metals.

title: Lam：先進封裝的蝕刻、電鍍與薄膜挑戰

sources.title: Inside the Chip: Powering the Future of Advanced Packaging

watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
scope: 先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。
scopeEn: Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type.

title: Lam Semi 101：先進封裝技術入門
watchFor: 多種晶片整合進同一封裝時，必須管理介面而不只是個別晶片。
精度、均勻性及可擴充性共同影響製程選擇。
可靠度課程需再加入失效與測試證據；此短片不能替代資格驗證。
watchForEn: Integrating different chips requires managing interfaces as well as individual dies.
Precision, uniformity and scalability jointly influence process choice.
Reliability lessons add failure and test evidence; this introduction cannot replace qualification.
scope: 封裝可靠度與共同設計的概念前導；沒有涵蓋所有應力試驗。
scopeEn: Conceptual preparation for package reliability and co-design; it does not cover every stress test.

title: Intel：60 秒認識玻璃封裝基板
watchFor: 玻璃核心與有機材料在平坦度及熱機械行為上有所差異。
分清測試單元、技術計畫與已量產產品三種證據。
基板材料改變仍需共同驗證通孔、金屬化及組裝界面。
watchForEn: Glass cores and organic materials differ in flatness and thermomechanical behavior.
Distinguish test units, technology plans and production products as separate evidence levels.
A substrate-material change still requires via, metallization and assembly-interface validation.
scope: 2023 年公開玻璃基板案例；不要把當時路線圖當成目前已完成的產品狀態。
scopeEn: A public 2023 glass-substrate case; do not treat its roadmap as proof of current product readiness.

title: AIM Photonics：組裝設計套件與晶片封裝共同設計

sources.title: Chip-Package Co-Design with AIM Photonics’ Assembly Design Kit

watchFor: 晶片設計早期就應納入封裝可達性及組裝接口。
ADK 的範本與模型協調設計和封裝流程；不等於自動保證良率。
記錄套件版本與適用平台，依授權取得真正設計資料。
watchForEn: Include packaging access and assembly interfaces early in chip design.
ADK templates and models coordinate design and packaging; they do not automatically guarantee yield.
Record kit version and target platform, and obtain actual design data under its license.
scope: PIC 封裝與設計流程的訪談導讀；未重製受限 PDK／ADK 檔案。
scopeEn: A guided interview on PIC packaging and design workflows; restricted PDK/ADK files are not reproduced.
